versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of the spex skill for spec-driven development workflows.
- Manages the full SDLC through manual command invocation via /spex <command>.
- Supports commands: create (new), modify, apply (run, do, go), apply-one-step (step), merge (submit), archive, and init.
- Features command routing to specific SOP files and intent inference for free-form input.
- Does not act on user prompts directly—always routes via the correct command procedure.
